name: Katie's Field Notes 3D
author: Paul D. Price
description_short: A cozy 3D birdwatching adventure: explore seven habitats and find, study and identify 184 real North American birds.
description_long: Pack your binoculars and field journal. Wander seven habitats, from a sunny meadow to a lighthouse seashore and a desert canyon, and identify 184 real birds by their field marks, size and song. Fill your field guide with notes and trivia, meet friendly hermits, care for a pet bird, and unlock four minigames. Family-friendly, with no combat. Needs about 240 MB free on the SD card, and saves to the memory card in slot A.
